title: Quasi-coherent modules on a scheme groupoid
statement: Let $U,R$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $(s,t,e,i,c)$ satisfy the groupoid laws [def-a1-scheme-groupoid-laws]. A quasi-coherent module on this groupoid consists of a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module $M$ [pqf-def-coherent] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and an isomorphism $\beta:t^*M\simeq s^*M$ [def-pc-module-pullback], with $e^*\beta=1$ and $c^*\beta=\operatorname{pr}_1^*\beta\circ\operatorname{pr}_0^*\beta$, under the canonical pullback identifications. A morphism $(M,\beta)\to(N,\gamma)$ is an underlying module map $f:M\to N$ satisfying $t^*f;\gamma=\beta;s^*f$. Identities and composition are those of underlying module maps. The forgetful functors send $(M,\beta)$ to $M$, into the full subcategory of quasi-coherent modules and into all module sheaves on $U$.
